import re

lib = Path('.refio/dat.gui.min.js').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
lib = re.sub(r'\n?//# sourceMappingURL=.*', '', lib)
inline = '<script>\n' + lib.replace('</script', '<\\/script') + '\n</script>'
pattern = r'<script\b[^>]*\bsrc=["\'][^"\']*(?:dat[.-]gui|dat\.gui)[^"\']*["\'][^>]*>\s*</script>'
s, count = re.subn(pattern, lambda m: inline, s, flags=re.I)
if not count:
    s = s.replace('</head>', inline + '\n</head>', 1)
